checks.description: required run files exist and parse (inputs.json, frozen/config.json, requests/*.jsonl)
every request line follows RECORDS (fields, enums, canonical masks, family/mask, known window_uid, result fields on successes, error lines carry 'error' only)
all successful lines sharing a result_key carry identical result fields (and the same target)

repeats 1/2 exist only for generations, only after an unparsed repeat r-1 of the identical input, and an unparsed repeat 0/1 is always regenerated (repeat r+1 logged); label = repeat 0 if parsed, else first parsed of repeats 1, 2
errors are retried at most twice per request (at most 3 error attempts per request_id, and at most 2 attempts that follow an error attempt)
every successful score line: finite readouts, S_hi_rounds_to_model_logits is true and equals bf16(hi_logit_k) == logit_k, S_hi is the FP32 difference of the head logits
inputs.json: unique window_uid == video_id@anchor, unique (video_id, frame_indices), 8 frame indices, 8 frame hashes, strata, development tags, slots in 0..7
frame_indices, window and clipped flag equal VERA's arithmetic for the anchor and the manifest length (inputs.json and frozen/manifest.json windows)
every successful line has 8 slot tensor hashes and slot_identity_ok is true

per input: unmasked slots of every masked line equal the unmasked input's slot hashes and every masked slot differs; unmasked lines agree across targets; a replaced slot has one hash per (input, family, slot) across all masks (no accumulated replacement)
the same (input, family, mask) always yields identical slot hashes and sequence_key across targets and repeats; distinct pixel inputs never share a sequence_key
PROTOCOL 6 schedule: every planned (target, family, mask) has at least one logged line; no unplanned requests; only Phase 0 when L0 is missing
replacing every grey record (scores and labels) leaves every blur ranking, native blur ranking, adaptive trajectory, prefix and T_w unchanged

adaptive trajectories (recomputed, and the analyzer's when present): every remaining slot is a candidate, no masked slot is re-selected, max-effect/lower-slot selection, step 1 equals fixed pi_1, prefixes and T_w follow the orders
derived/rankings.jsonl equals the recomputation: one record per label-available input; L0, q, baseline, three fixed RANKINGs, adaptive states, prefixes, T_w
results/primary.json equals the recomputed primary estimate, bootstrap interval, stability seeds, n's, video means, d_w, worst-case bounds and sensitivities
results/inputs_metrics.csv equals the recomputation (d_w, F_top2, F_random_mean, n_pair_labels, e_w, L0, q, T_w, tau_b and overlaps when present)
results/pairs.csv equals the recomputation: one row per (label-available input, family, pair) with S_hi, S, D, J and, on grey, label and flip
results/trajectories.csv equals the recomputation: per (input, mode, k) the grey-evaluated prefix mask, label, flip, q*dS_hi and q*dS
experiment02 erratum E1 from raw score records: |Delta S_hi| < S_resolution rows whose native BF16 margin still changes (expected 36 of 109 of 168), cross-checked against temporal_effects.csv

e1.native_difference_definition: Delta_bf16 = (logit_1 - logit_0)(base) - (logit_1 - logit_0)(mask); the stored S field carries <= 1.2e-7 float noise from log-prob subtraction, so its literal difference is reported separately (n_substep_raw_S_field_nonzero); temporal_effects.csv prints Delta_bf16 to 6 decimals (agrees with the margin difference) but computed its Delta_bf16_zero flag from the raw S fields

readings: latest line: request lines are ordered by request file name (sorted) and then line number
parsed label = parse_status 'ok' with an integer label 0/1; repeats 1/2 are expected only after an unparsed repeat r-1 of the same generation; score requests have repeat 0 only
native readout = logit_1 - logit_0 (protocol/RECORDS v1.1; the stored S field carries ~1e-7 log-softmax noise)
development = video_id in the protocol's two development videos (or tagged so in inputs.json)
primary population ignores inputs.json status (any input with parsed L0 = 1); planned-request checks cover status 'ok' inputs only
a successful line with a non-finite readout is treated as a missing value
a RANKING whose baseline score is missing is incomplete with 'baseline' in its missing list
ties lists only groups of size >= 2 and is compared as an unordered set of sorted groups

d_w, F_top2 and F_random_mean are defined for L0 = 1 inputs only (F = 1 iff label 0); L0 = 0 rows are not compared for them; F_random_mean with missing labels is accepted blank or as the mean of available labels
if T_w is undefined (incomplete blur ranking) d_w is missing and the bound uses selected = 0 / 1
e_w is missing unless the baseline score, T_w and all 28 grey-pair S_hi values are present
n_videos = videos with at least one non-missing d_w (the bootstrap V)

bootstrap results (ci95_pp and stability ci95_pp) are compared endpoint by endpoint within 1e-9 pp (the protocol fixes the draws and the percentile rule, not float summation order); the validator sums with Python's built-in sum in input order within a video and video_id order across videos; percentile = s[lo] + (s[hi]-s[lo])*frac; pp = 100 * value at the end
sensitivity estimates use the primary seed and B; their CIs are compared only when the analyzer reports them
E1 native difference uses the BF16 logit margin (logit_1 - logit_0); the stored S field differs from it by <= 1.2e-7 and its literal difference is reported separately
a retry is any attempt logged after an error attempt of the same request_id (global line order); more than two retries or more than three error attempts per request_id fail retry_limit
an unparsed successful generation at repeat r < 2 must be followed by a logged line (any cache_status) for repeat r + 1; an errored repeat does not oblige a further repeat
a replaced slot's tensor hash depends only on (input, family, slot), since every mask is rebuilt from the original frames; two hashes for one (input, family, slot) fail slot_identity
manifest window records with status 'unavailable' have no window and are not checked against VERA arithmetic
